Full B10 and B11 pending; source-aligned unified-lighting prerequisite has8exact tests, no renderer activation.

sources.title: Gradient-Domain ReSTIR Path Tracing
sources.quality: Primary author/publisher source; reading extent explicit.
sources.limitations: Assumes affine object transforms. High-frequency temporal turbulence remains without temporal gradients; reconstruction is an additional cost. sources.notes: Resample paired-pixel paths directly in gradient space, with adaptive edge-aligned spatial reuse and positive/negative reservoirs to reduce sign noise; reconstruct using a separate primal Area ReSTIR image. Locator: Sections 4.1–4.4, 5 Results, 6 Discussion and Conclusion; Figures 9–12 Falcor, RTX 5090, Ryzen 5900X, 1920×1080 moving camera. L2 Poisson reconstruction costs 11 ms; L1 costs 300 ms. L2 cost is included in equal-time comparisons.

sources.title: Many-Light Rendering Using ReSTIR-Sampled Shadow Maps
sources.quality: Primary author/publisher source; reading extent explicit.
sources.limitations: Two reservoirs prevent ranking/shading feedback flicker; combining them degrades stability or noise. Imperfect maps approximate visibility, so this is not exact ray-traced visibility. Publisher full-text Section 3, plus author abstract; direct PDF too large.
sources.notes: Use a ranking reservoir process to select a budgeted subset of full-resolution light shadow maps, with imperfect shadow maps elsewhere; a separate shading reservoir process evaluates lighting. Variance-based hysteresis stabilizes upgrades and downgrades. Locator: Sections 3.1 Selecting Lights, 3.2 Practical Algorithm, 3.3 Maintaining Temporal Stability Targets rasterized many-light shadow-map computation/storage.

sources.title: Area ReSTIR: Resampling for Real-time Defocus and Antialiasing
sources.quality: Primary author/publisher source; reading extent explicit.
sources.limitations: Aperture support and shift Jacobians matter; primary-hit reconnection can leave the aperture. General filters alter overlap/MIS weights. The author repository publishes only the DI implementation, modifies scene-history storage outside its module, and warns module-only copying produces bias/errors; noisy camera-domain G-buffers challenge denoisers. Author project abstract and indexed paper Sections 4.1–4.6 excerpts; complete large PDF unavailable in web extraction.
sources.notes: Include film and lens coordinates in the reservoir domain. Fractional-pixel temporal tracking and camera-aware shifts improve reuse of subpixel detail and defocus. The robust option can borrow shifted samples from four overlapping prior reservoirs. Locator: Sections 4.1 Area Reservoirs, 4.3 Temporal Reuse, 4.4 General Pixel Filters, 4.6 Depth of Field Supports antialiasing and depth of field; basis for later splatting and gradient-domain work.

sources.title: Decorrelating ReSTIR Samplers via MCMC Mutations
sources.quality: Primary author/publisher source; reading extent explicit.
sources.limitations: Non-negligible runtime; can improve perceptual correlation without lowering MSE. It is not a discovery mechanism for missing important transport, and even unlimited mutations need not remove all correlations. Publisher full-text method Section 3 and limitations Section 7; indexed paper excerpts.
sources.notes: Mutate selected reservoir samples using Metropolis–Hastings, usually after temporal reuse; update the contribution weight by the old/new target-function ratio before further resampling. Locator: Section 3 Method, Equation 16, Algorithm 3, Section 7 Limitations; Figures 12–13 Demonstrated in DI and PT; mutations address correlation and duplicate-sample impoverishment.
